tickets.title: VSA Engine â€” bipolar bind, bundle, cosine, cleanup with straight-through estimator
acceptance_criteria: bind(a, b) returns element-wise multiply of bipolar vectors
bundle(vectors, weights) returns weighted sum + sign normalization
cosine(a, b) returns correct similarity
cleanup(query, codebook) returns nearest codebook entry with straight-through gradient
All ops differentiable; gradient flows verified in unit test

tickets.title: NodeBank â€” stateful node population with nu, e, tau, sigma, budget
acceptance_criteria: NodeBank holds (max_nodes, dim) prediction vectors nu
Tracks per-node error e, temporal trace tau, node type sigma, budget b
update_errors(shape) computes prediction error from input shape
Silent node decay: tau *= lambda_tau, e *= lambda_e_silent per pulse

tickets.title: SCE â€” spike decision rule with surrogate gradient and phase-dependent thresholds
acceptance_criteria: spike_i = 1 iff e_i > tau_spike(phase, sigma_i, b_i)
Thresholds: perceptive=0.30, compositional=0.20, recursive=0.10, commit=0.40
Straight-through estimator surrogate: 1/(1+|e_i - tau_spike|)^2
Silent nodes: trace decays, prediction unchanged, error decays at 0.95
Unit test: >= 80% silent nodes on synthetic familiar inputs

tickets.title: Attractor Library â€” codebook store, cosine retrieval, pruning by utility
acceptance_criteria: Max 10,000 entries, ~200MB memory cap
Insert if no match (cos < 0.6)
Retrieve via cosine top-k cleanup
Prune lowest-utility entries when cap exceeded

tickets.title: Curiosity Engine â€” event detection, goal generation, scheduling, resolution
acceptance_criteria: Detect curiosity event: e_i > 0.50 AND dl_i > 2.5 AND budget < 30% AND node not committed
Generate CuriosityGoal shape with target_VSA, priority, budget_reserve
Store in ERS with utility_score=0.80
Schedule: load pending goals at episode start if cos > 0.40
Resolve: promote to Semantic if cos(committed, target) > 0.65; else reschedule with +0.10 priority

tickets.title: Temporal Motif Library â€” detection, storage, promotion gates
acceptance_criteria: Detect motif candidate: seq >= 3 pulses, recurrence >= 5, similarity >= 0.75
Store temporal_motif_shape with pulse_sequence_VSA, trigger_VSA, outcome_VSA, success_rate
Promotion gates: recurrence >= 10, success_rate >= 0.75, pulse_savings >= 3, interference <= 0.03
Motif replay: inject pre-formed shapes in Perceptive regime, verify with preliminary check

tickets.title: Growth Ledger â€” node spawning, attractor expansion, pruning protocol
acceptance_criteria: Spawn new node when persistent error > 0.6 for 5 pulses; initialize nu_new = nu_i + noise
Max nodes = 5,000 hard cap
Attractor expansion: add if no cos > 0.6 match; cap at 10k; prune lowest utility
Growth rate <= compression rate constraint tracked in ledger

tickets.title: ARC Grid Dataset â€” synthetic pattern completion without language
acceptance_criteria: Generate synthetic ARC-style grids: input grid + target completed grid
Configurable grid_size and vocab
Returns dict with type='arc', input_grid, target_grid tensors
Supports DataLoader with custom collate

tickets.title: Relational Graph Dataset â€” entity-relation triples with masked prediction
acceptance_criteria: Generate structured (entity, relation, entity) triples
Task: predict masked entity or relation element
Returns dict with type='graph', entities, relations, target_entity, target_relation
Configurable vocab_size, num_entities

tickets.title: PSN2System core â€” Phase A-F loop, grid encoder/decoder, graph encoder/decoder
acceptance_criteria: forward_batch handles both 'arc' and 'graph' batch types
Grid path: encode_grid â†’ NodeBank aggregation â†’ grid_decoder â†’ cross-entropy loss
Graph path: encode_graph â†’ NodeBank aggregation â†’ entity/relation decoders â†’ loss
Loss = L_pred + 0.1 * L_shape + 0.01 * L_spike
maybe_grow on high error triggers curiosity goals and attractor expansion

tickets.title: Checkpoint System â€” serialize/resume all state across Kaggle sessions
acceptance_criteria: Serialize: model state_dict, attractor library, curiosity goals, motif library, growth ledger, node errors/traces
Format: PyTorch state dict + JSON metadata
Checkpoint every 30 minutes and at session end
Resume: load all state and continue training from last step
Round-trip test: save â†’ load â†’ verify identical state

tickets.title: Training Loop â€” D1/D2 mixed curriculum with ARC (60%) + graphs (40%)
acceptance_criteria: Mixed training: sample ARC grids with p=0.60, relational graphs with p=0.40
Phase progression: perceptive â†’ compositional â†’ recursive over training steps
Gradient clipping at 1.0
Logging: loss_pred, loss_shape, loss_spike, attractor count, goal count
Configurable via configs/default.json

tickets.title: ERS Memory System â€” Working/Episodic/Semantic tiers with promotion and decay
acceptance_criteria: Three tiers: Working (ephemeral), Episodic (session), Semantic (compressed)
Store tuples: (input_VSA, trace_VSA, output_VSA, source, utility_score)
Promotion: utility > 0.7 promotes Working â†’ Episodic â†’ Semantic
Decay: each tier has configurable decay_state
Retrieval by cosine similarity with tau_ers=0.45 threshold
Memory bounded: prune lowest utility on overflow

tickets.title: Phase A-F Pulse Cycle â€” proper multi-phase prediction-error loop
acceptance_criteria: Phase A: evidence integration (proximal + modulatory inputs)
Phase B: bond update via VSA bind mechanics
Phase C: morphogenic field â€” role and type transitions, shape induction
Phase D: shape formation â€” coalition detection, stability computation
Phase E: verifier gate â€” suppress unsupported shapes
Phase F: commitment â€” render buffer output, dissolve unstable shapes
Each phase respects spike_gate: only spiking nodes participate
Multi-pulse iteration with budget tracking

tickets.title: Bond System â€” typed VSA bonds with permutation indices and legality matrix
acceptance_criteria: Bond types vocabulary: causal, temporal, spatial, part-whole + 10 linguistic (P_10â€“P_19)
Bond formation: bind(perm_TYPE(a.semantic_v), b.semantic_v)
Bond strength tracking per pulse with decay lambda=0.90
Legality matrix: which bond types can connect which shape types
Bond recovery test: unbind + cleanup recovers original vectors

tickets.title: Emotional Shape System (ESS) â€” 8 emotional types with bond-mediated influence

Emotional shape induction via morphogenic MLP in Phase C
Emotional bonds: bind(perm_EMO(E.semantic_v), S.centroid_nu)
delta_theta_commit: signed effect per emotional type on bonded shape thresholds
lambda_emo=0.85 decay per pulse (faster than cognitive bonds)
Emotional calibration loss L_emo_calib active from D3+

tickets.title: Field Vector Compatibility Bridge â€” map legacy F_t to ESS mechanisms
acceptance_criteria: All 7 legacy field dimensions mapped: focusâ†’attention-narrowing bond, curiosityâ†’CE goal, cautionâ†’fear emotional shape, urgencyâ†’urgency emotional shape, playâ†’novelty emotional shape, consistencyâ†’self-shape regulatory bond, aestheticâ†’aesthetic self-shape
No legacy field vector code path remains active

tickets.title: Lexical Attractor Library (LAL) â€” word shape storage and retrieval
acceptance_criteria: Word shape schema: semantic_v (R^D), syntactic_v (R^512), pragmatic_v (R^256), freq_v (R^16), phi_i (float)

Retrieval via VSA cleanup projection (cosine top-k)

tickets.title: Linguistic Bond Types â€” 10 bond types with VSA permutation indices P_10â€“P_19
acceptance_criteria: 10 bond types: MODIFIES, DETERMINES, SUBJECT_OF, OBJECT_OF, PREDICATE_OF, DISCOURSE_CONTINUES, DISCOURSE_CONTRASTS, DISCOURSE_GROUNDS, COREFERS_WITH, SCOPES_OVER

Output: list of (i, j, bond_type, strength) tuples

generate(committed_shape): LAL cleanup â†’ syntax_decoder â†’ pragmatics_renderer â†’ verifier check â†’ emit or veto

tickets.title: Inner Speech Loop (ISL) â€” draft verbal propositions as modulatory evidence
acceptance_criteria: Trigger: regime==Recursive AND uncertainty > 0.55 AND pulse_remaining > B_max/4
